purpose: Review four wave-001 survivors and twelve completely new painted one-star identities as summon/chibi pairs, with strict body-proportion continuity.
candidateBoundary: Nothing in this experiment is approved or runtime-ready. A Keep decision means worth developing, not catalog promotion.

batchRules.renderingRegister: cinematic semi-realistic painted character drawing; visibly illustrated, never photographic
batchRules.combatDerivative: approximately three-head chibi; cuteness comes from head and simplification, never generic body or arm inflation

knownIssues: The image generator baked a white-and-light-gray checkerboard into the chibi RGB pixels instead of returning an alpha channel.
Chibi transparency cleanup and canvas normalization happen only after selection; these files remain valid identity and body-match candidates.
